Ancestrals

The ancestrals are a group of monsters represented as constellations in the Elduran night sky. In the Kingdom, twelve prominent constellations can be found throughout the year, each of which associated with one of the ancestrals described here.

The humans of the Kingdom see proginor as a creature made only of ravens’ wings and eyes. The elves see it as a creature of rainbow-colored plumage, and the dwarves believe it to be comprised of leathery, lizard scales stretched over hollow bones. Further research is required to determine if these stories all relate to the same monsters or different ones.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

PROGINOR
CR 13

XP 25,600
NG Medium outsider (air, extraplanar)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., True Seeing; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 27, flat-footed 18 (+10 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural)
hp 153 (18d10+54); fast healing 10
Fort +15, Ref +16, Will +15
Defensive Abilities all-around vision; Immune acid, electricity; Resist cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee slam +20 (1d6+2)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 18th)

Constant—true seeing
At will—magic missile, mirror image, ray of frost, shield
3/day—invisibility, eyebite, prying eyes, quickened magic missile, quickened shield
1/day—winds of vengeance

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 30, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 28, Cha 13
Base Atk +18; CMB +20; CMD 40 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Dodge, Great Fortitude, Mobility, Skill Focus (fly, perception), Quicken Spell-Like Ability (magic missile, shield), Wind Stance, Toughness
Skills Fly +23, Knowledge (planes) +10, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +15, Survival +11; Racial Modifiers +4 Fly, +8 Perception
Languages Auran, Common
SQ trainer spells (CL 13)
